steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*... Matoimaru, tell me... we're almost there...

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Yeah, real soon!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Pick up the pace! We've gotta stop him before he gives that scammer any more money!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Dammit, I'm not gonna let him do this...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: *pant*... I've never heard you... talk about your family before...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What's your dad like...? Some kinda... super-burly Oni hulk?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Cause if he is... I dunno if I'll be any help talking him down...

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Relax, Dad's not an Oni, just your average old Vulpo.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: He adopted me when I was real young—didn't care I had Oni horns growing in. He raised me all the way.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: I'm not gonna let him get dragged into any of the messes I've made since leaving home, so I've never really brought him up.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: But since he’s the one who caused this mess, there’s nothing I can do.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Doesn't matter how, we've gotta get it through his skull he's being duped!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Scams like this have been on the rise in Higashi lately... I saw the news in Mitsukue reporting on it...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: It's scary to think... Even your relative got hit...

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Good thing you guys investigate fast. I woulda been way too late on my own.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: We're here! This is the village!
Matoimaru maintains her breakneck sprint, her operator companion huffing for air as he straggles behind. The Higashinese village is still and quiet, a vista of peace in the rays of early summer.
A villager in thin clothes emerges onto the path to hail the two, only to halt upon seeing Matoimaru, whereupon he begins to wave enthusiastically.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Villager
steps.text: Yo! If it isn't Matoimaru-chan! Finally made time to come back and visit us?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Villager
steps.text: Hold on, what's the rush? Somewhere to be?

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: No time to chat! I gotta get home fast!
Matoimaru completely forgoes the usual pleasantries with the old man, merely jabbing in the direction of her house before dashing away from him.
The man stumbles back a step out of surprise, and shakes his head as he watches the Oni girl go.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Villager
steps.text: Gone for so many years, and now she's suddenly racing for home? Is Eikichi in trouble?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Villager
steps.text: ...Surely not. Eikichi's not the trouble-finding sort.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Excuse me, sir, I'm sorry about this... Once I have the chance, I'll explain what happened...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hold up, Matoimaru!
Watching the two figures speed off, the villager scratched his head in confusion.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: And honestly, 'fake'? How can this be fake?

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: All I had to pay was a small processing fee, and they sent me the first payout just the day before. I've hit the jackpot, true and honest.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: It's a fine opportunity, and I've no reason to pass it up—

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: What? You already gave them the money?

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Matoimaru! I told you to stay out of this—why did you come back anyway?

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: You come home without a word, and look, you just barrel in! Look at the door! Look at the flower vase you knocked over! See?

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Honestly, girl. Never mind the damage—what baffles me is I finally come into some wealth and all you want is to pull me away from it.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: What do you want me to tell you, huh?!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Says you, Dad! I explained it to you and you still ignored me!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Lotteries like these are scams. I saw the exact same grift when I went to Kazimierz.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: I've been around more than you now. It's your turn to listen to me. I'm serious. This is gonna screw you.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: In fact, I'm so serious, I brought a coworker you can trust with me, he's... he should be here real soon.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: We've looked into the scammer! We even know where he is, and what he's up to! That has to convince you, right?!

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Yes, yes, Matoimaru, you've been places.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: But you've been out there so long, you missed how Higashi changed. You don’t know what it’s like for us.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: And don't tell me about Kazimierz. I know about Kazimierz, but this isn't Kazimierz. Higashi is in its boom era now, understand.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: And you should learn to stop crying scam at every little thing. Remember Katsushi next door? I let you play at his place all the time when you were young.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: He hit the jackpot too. He doesn't even live here anymore. I bet he's flying free in Mitsukue right about now.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Dad, be real for a sec!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Doesn't matter where in the land you are, you only get as much back as the effort you put in. I learned that in my very first year away from home.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: It's because things are so much cushier now, because so many people want a quick and easy fortune, that all these scammers crawled outta the woodwork!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: You can't give into greed like that! It just makes you into another mark!

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Enough, enough! How can it be fake when I already got a payout? If this is how it's going to be, just get back to your job.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Look, once I get all the money, maybe you won't have to break your back out there anymore. We can move to the city and have ourselves an easy life.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Okay? Stop letting your anger speak for you.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hold on... *pant*...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Sorry... Matoimaru... didn't think you lived this deep in the mountains...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Nice to... meet you, sir... I'm a colleague of Matoimaru's here...

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Finally! Quick, help me talk to him! I suck at explaining all the details!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Listen to him, okay, Dad? We did the investigation. We know the truth. You'll understand once you hear it!

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: No, I know everything I need to. You're wasting your time, no?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: (Takes a deep breath)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: On the contrary, sir. Details in your letter raised Matoimaru's suspicions, and we amassed copious evidence while aiding her investigation to back our findings.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Scams disguised as notices of lottery wins have been reported all over Higashi. Did you receive a message telling you to pay a handling fee before you could receive your reward?

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Just a little processing fee, yes. But look, I already got some money out from it, right?

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: How can this be a racket if they're paying me?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: That's one of the methods these fraudsters use. They pay their victims part of the money, before asking you to pay even larger handling fees, bit by bit.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We've already tracked down where your messages are coming from, based on how previous incidents of this kind played out. The source is an insurance firm in Mitsukue.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: If you could take a look here, these messages are all from the operating committee for a television program called 'Fortune 24/7', right?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: But the reality is, someone from that firm is posing as this committee in order to send out these fabricated messages.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We advise you that you cannot trust any future communications that come from them, and you cannot continue to meet their demands.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Thank you!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: See, here's an in-depth report from the Mitsukue papers. These are all the fake notices other people got, saying they'd won. They're basically the same as yours, aren't they?

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: You HAVE to believe us now!
Matoimaru pulls paper after paper from the operator's binder, and lays them all out on the tatami for her foster father to see.
She watches earnestly to see how he'll react, only for him to shake his head.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Settle down, Matoimaru.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: You know we've never been wealthy. This is a chance for us to live the good life...

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: And none of the stuff you're showing me can prove the jackpot I hit isn't real.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Just go, the both of you. Don't try and test me with this rubbish.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Dad, even I learned not to get duped like I used to! How can you fall for this kind of scam?!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: You—
Abruptly, Eikichi rises, and pushes Matoimaru out the door with both hands.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Enough! I have a life to live! Don't you bother me anymore!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Sir, please calm down! Sir!
But the operator's exhortations make Eikichi no less eager to get Matoimaru out.
She doesn't put up a fight. Removed from the room, she and her father stare each other down for a few fractious seconds, before she silently turns and leaves.
The operator can only hurry to gather up the scattered papers from the floor, before apologizing as he slips out of the room.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: *Sigh*!
On seeing how the two have knocked over the entryway ornaments, Eikichi stamps a foot and sighs.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Matoimaru!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Don't give up. It's not over just because we didn't convince him. After all, it's true we don't have decisive evidence.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We're limited in how much we can investigate. Maybe we can wait for the authorities to step in after all.
The operator flips through his binder, poring over all the evidence within, failing to notice when Matoimaru suddenly lifts her head.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: No. It's not catching the scammer that matters most. It's getting Dad to understand this whole thing's a racket.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Right, I've got it, the most decisive evidence there is...

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: If the scammer himself admits it, then there's no way Dad can keep claiming his win is real!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What are you implying?

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: We're gonna go to Mitsukue right now, and we're gonna get that sucker.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: I'll make him confess, straight from the burdenbeast's mouth!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What? Matoimaru, we don't have the authority to just seize people like that. Without a warrant from the authorities, we—

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Don't worry, I've got a plan. It starts now!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: C'mon, stick with me!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Matoimaru!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We can take the car this time! Matoimaru!
Mitsukue, in the afternoon...
A speeding car brakes to a lurching stop outside an insurance firm, and the operator almost flies out of the passenger seat from the inertia.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: We're finally here. You're sure that asshole works here?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Guh... Are you sure you're licensed to drive?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Whatever, I guess that bridge is crossed. Yes, as long as our results are sound, he's definitely in there.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: But we still don't have confirmation of who he is exactly, and I don't think it's a good idea to just barge into their office like this.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: I told you, I've got a plan.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Listen to me. You stay in the car, and keep in contact. I'll head in solo to handle things. We can't go letting 'em catch sight of Rhodes Island's uniform.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: They'll think I'm just some Oni thug from the Mitsukue, here to see someone. Nobody'll even try to stop me.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: People who only have the spine for dirty methods like this are all cowards. He'll fold just from the fright. I'll nab him, just you watch.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Are you sure about this? What if he clams up and won't confess?

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Relax. When in Higashi, do as the Higashinese do. He'd probably run if the police came to make an arrest, but if he hears the Mafioso came knocking, he'll be REAL desperate to play nice.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Plus, we've got proof. It didn't win over Dad, but it'll definitely convince that little scammer there's eyes on him.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Sit tight, and I'll drag him out in a sec!
With that, Matoimaru swiftly hops out of the car, and strides for the office entrance.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: How do I even write the mission report...?
It's afternoon in a small Higashinese firm, and its suited-up office workers are all buried in their desk work.
Suddenly, the sound of heavy stomping makes everyone lift their heads and look to the entrance.
There stands a robust Oni wielding a naginata, and on her left is the front desk receptionist in a stiff bow, looking somewhat hapless.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Listen close, I'm only gonna say it once! I'm here for someone!
The Oni's sudden bark, her voice loud and clear, makes everyone sit up straight in their seats.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: One of you has been posing as the 'Fortune 24/7' Operation Committee, sending out a LOT of scam jackpot wins telling folks they'll get their prize as soon as they fork over a handler's fee.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Smells like someone's awful keen on getting rich. It's a nasty way to do it, I won't lie.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Well. I dunno who else you swindled, and right now, I don't care. But how dare you come after us!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: We tracked you down from the notice you sent. You got nowhere to run.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Now step up and fess up! And even if you don't, you can't escape us forever. If we sniff you out, we'll sure you know what kinda treatment you get for not following our rules!
The Oni's grip on her naginata tightens. Each time one of her sentences ends, the office is silent enough to hear a pin drop. The desk workers are too terrified to even look away.
Following a brief hush, a single hand in the corner of the workplace slowly raises, and quivers as it weaves through the maze of desks and mountains of papers, eventually arriving before the Oni.

steps.name: Nervous Worker
steps.text: I beg you, please spare me...

steps.name: Nervous Worker
steps.text: I'll do anything you ask... I don't want to die...
The Oni looks over the fearful, stooped man. Her expression remains stonily fixed. She pulls out a sheet of paper from her bag, and unfolds it in front of the employee.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: You the one sending these notices?
The employee timidly lifts his gaze, once-overs the words on the page, and nods promptly.
The naginata-wielding Oni says nothing more, dragging him backwards out of the office by his collar.
The silence in the building hangs for a while longer. Then it breaks, and the entire street can hear the sheer commotion coming from within.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: *sigh*... Finally got it all arranged again. I put her own ikebana display here—can't be wrecking that.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: But it's strange. They should've sent me my winnings by now, but I haven't heard a single thing from them since.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: No, stop it. Katsushi got his payout, didn't he? Dammit, why did he have to vanish? If I could just ask him...
Eikichi paces the room, deep in contemplation, when he hears a familiar voice once more outside his door.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: We're here, you little bastard! You're gonna apologize to my dad, personally! Are we clear?!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Dad, I caught the scammer for you!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: You can hear it straight from his mouth just how he swindled the cash.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Get talking!

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Wh-What's the meaning of this?
Eikichi looks down, and only then sees the suited man Matoimaru's dragged in with her. His face is deathly pale, and utterly fixed with fright.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Matoimaru, let him go! Look, you've scared the daylights out of him!

steps.name: Nervous Worker
steps.text: No, no, sir, please, I really did do it.

steps.name: Nervous Worker
steps.text: And I shouldn't have, not in a million years, not when it meant swindling you! I take all the blame!

steps.name: Nervous Worker
steps.text: I beg you, tell your daughter not to kill me! I was short on money and desperate—so desperate I thought up this scam of all things...

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Hmm? How does that add up?

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Isn't that Fortune 24/7 program supposed to be famous in Mitsukue?

steps.name: Nervous Worker
steps.text: No, sir, it was a guise for me to fool people. Trick them with talk of jackpots, and then once people in Mitsukue got wise to it, I moved to looking outside the city...

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: This coward kept his demands low at first, scared he'd be found out.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: But once he discovered people outside Mitsukue don't have a clue about programs like this, he found way easier marks, so he began sending fake notices all over.

steps.name: Nervous Worker
steps.text: The—um, everyone around me had the cash to live it up, and I just wanted that too...

steps.name: Nervous Worker
steps.text: If I had more money, I wouldn't need to work in that cramped little office, and I wouldn't need to live cooped up in my stuffy little room...

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: So where's the money? Sounds like you're not exactly living it up yet.

steps.name: Nervous Worker
steps.text: Don't laugh at me, I...

steps.name: Nervous Worker
steps.text: Every time I got the money, I'd blow it all on cards and pachinko, and lose it all. I couldn't think of any other ways to get rich...

steps.name: Nervous Worker
steps.text: We work in insurance, so it's easy to get the customers' contact details. All we need is a name, and it's not hard to gain their trust.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Dad, if all that evidence before wasn't enough, you just heard the scammer confess it himself. No room for doubt now, right?

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: This was always a racket from the very beginning. You can't trust get-rich-quick crap like this.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: But... but if it was fake, then what about the money Katsushi got?

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Surely you're not telling me you forced an innocent man to confess to guilt?

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Matoimaru, this is a line you just can't cross...

steps.name: Nervous Worker
steps.text: She did no such thing, sir, you have to believe me! You have to, or it's my head!

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: A younger me might've pulled some stupid stunt, Dad.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: But my colleagues helped me uncover the evidence, and only then did I have the guts to haul this scammer out.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Besides—
Before Matoimaru can finish, a woman's shrill voice filters in from outside.
Get out here, you swindler! Matoimaru, bring him to me this instant!

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Is... is that Akiyo?
Eikichi opens the door, only to be taken aback by a sizeable congregation of fellow villagers at his doorstep, his neighbor Katsushi's wife Akiyo at their fore.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Friends, what's going on here?

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: I haven't seen you in a long time, Akiyo. What brings you back? Where's Katsushi? Why isn't he with you?

steps.name: Akiyo
steps.text: Eikichi-nii, I owe a very deep debt of thanks to your Matoimaru.

steps.name: Akiyo
steps.text: If it weren't for her, I'd have gone the rest of my life not knowing where this waste of breath went.

steps.name: Akiyo
steps.text: Just now, Shigezou-ojisan caught sight of her lugging this cur back, her coworker explained the whole situation to him, and he came running over to our place.

steps.name: Akiyo
steps.text: Until then, I had no idea the man who scammed my Katsushi was back again and cheating you too.

steps.name: Akiyo
steps.text: Thanks to Matoimaru, we've finally caught the scoundrel!

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: What? Katsushi was scammed, you say? Then why did he never tell me? Why did you never tell me?

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Didn't he win the jackpot and move away? I haven't seen hide nor hair of him in forever! I thought you'd gone with him!

steps.name: Akiyo
steps.text: How could I tell you? Not only did he never get the money, he was swindled to the point we almost lost our house and home.

steps.name: Akiyo
steps.text: After that, he went out looking for work to repay the debt, and I've not heard from him since.

steps.name: Akiyo
steps.text: How humiliating would it be if people learned of this, especially now that I'm on my own? How could I tell you, or anyone? I could only hole up and bear it alone at home.

steps.name: Akiyo
steps.text: Now I hear the cheat's finally been caught—I can... finally...
At that point, Akiyo's shrill voice falters, and the young wife breaks down in tears in front of everyone.
The villagers stare at the fraudster lying trembling on the ground, and at the stunned Eikichi in his doorway, and begin to murmur.

steps.name: Onlooking Villager
steps.text: Goodness, look. Look at what he's driven poor Akiyo to.

steps.name: Enraged Villager
steps.text: The man's obviously a habitual crook! Just can't help himself, no matter how many he deceives! It's about time he was taught a lesson!

steps.name: Onlooking Villager
steps.text: Exactly. How could anyone forgive him?

steps.name: Enraged Villager
steps.text: Matoimaru! Give this swindler a real what-for! Don't stop beating him until he can't draw breath!

steps.name: Onlooking Villager
steps.text: Beat him!

steps.name: Onlooking Villager
steps.text: Beat him!
Little by little, the villagers lift their voices in clamor. Again and again, the man bows as low as he can, his face pale as death, but he can no longer squeeze out any pleas for forgiveness.
In contrast, Matoimaru simply shakes her head before approaching Eikichi.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Calm down, everyone. This man's been out of control, I agree. He's hurt who-knows-how-many just for money. He even swindled my dad. I'm as pissed as you are.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: But I didn't drag him here so anyone could vent on him.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: If beating the crap out of him would've solved everything, then his breaths would've been numbered by the time I found him in Mitsukue.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Matoimaru...

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: I brought him here so others could learn not to get scammed as easy as I used to.

steps.name: Akiyo
steps.text: But... we can't just—let this scoundrel go...

steps.name: Akiyo
steps.text: All the money he cheated us out of...

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Akiyo-nee, trust me, this guy's not escaping punishment, and there'll be settlement for all the money lost.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: No matter what's happened, things WILL get better from now on.
Police sirens wail from the road outside the village. Matoimaru looks past the crowd and over toward the binder-toting operator who catches her gaze and nods the sign to her.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: And don’t fret. People will be here real soon to handle him.
The sky begins to darken. The police apprehend and take away the fraudster. Soon, the crowd surrounding Eikichi's door disperses.
As a stick of bug-repellent incense burns, a small room is now host to no one but father and daughter. Eikichi sits in seiza on the tatami flooring, not quite certain where to rest his gaze.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Say, um. Matoimaru, you know. Your dad's been a fool. Shouldn't have gone blaming you like that.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Almost fell for that rotten gambler's scheme. Made a fool of myself in front of the whole village.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: *sigh* I've no right to judge. I was blinded by the quick money, just like...
Matoimaru sits next to him, and listens. In lieu of an immediate response, she silently shuffles closer, until she's close enough they could lean on each other.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: What're ya talking about, Dad? Doesn't matter if you got scammed. Just don't fall for it again.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: If I was the old me, I woulda been no help. Bet I'd be stumped where he even got his hooks into you.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: And besides...
The Oni girl awkwardly reaches over and holds Eikichi's hand resting on the tatami floor, as her face breaks into a grin.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Life's changed. I'm not a kid anymore. It's my turn to look after you now, Dad.
Eikichi glances at his adopted daughter, and his taut expression finally begins to relax.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Say, there's one more thing.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: What you said to the village folk when they were calling for that cheat to be taught a lesson? That didn't sound like something you'd say.

steps.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father
steps.text: Sure you didn't rough him up in secret? A younger you would never have let his kind off the hook, you know.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: I told you, Dad. Someday I'd stop being that gullible little dummy.

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: And hey, you know the saying?

steps.name: Matoimaru
steps.text: Even the most vicious Oni will discover peace someday.
Matoimaru turns her head, and glances over at the entryway with its warm lights overhead. There on a wooden shelf, her very own ikebana has been put on display.
